title: Scheduling, Retrying, and Automating Scripts
description: Run Python jobs reliably on a schedule, with retries and clear failure signals.
learningOutcomes: Schedule recurring jobs in-process and via cron
Add resilient retry logic with tenacity
Design a script that is safe to re-run

lessons.title: cron and In-process Scheduling
lessons.description: When to use cron versus schedule/APScheduler.
learningObjectives: Choose cron vs a long-running scheduler

lessons.title: Retrying with tenacity
lessons.description: Declarative retry policies instead of hand-rolled retry loops.
learningObjectives: Add retry with backoff using tenacity
Retry only on the right exceptions
Cap retries and surface final failures

lessons.title: Designing Idempotent Scripts
lessons.description: Make a script safe to run twice by accident.

lessons.title: Logging and Alerting for Scripts
lessons.description: Know when an automated job failed, without watching it manually.
learningObjectives: Add structured logging to a script
Record a job's last successful run
